name: Street postcard proof and Lob test

config.prompt: Your step: review the full 11.5 x 6.25 inch postcard proof, recipient list, sender, address checks, suppression result, selected route, piece weight, print quantity, and budget in the preceding run result. Approve this test-mode Lob postcard check? This flow creates a local proof only and does not order or send mail.

Your step: save the customer-approved route card at $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/coop-postcards/intake/route-card.json. Include campaign_id; town, route_id, and November fill_by date; from.name; to.address_line1; mailpiece length/height/thickness in inches and weight in ounces; each buyer category and written_approval; and street_jobs with street addresses only (no homeowner names). Return and approve after the file is ready. Complete Lob test setup in Glacier Settings → Secrets only for the optional test-mode check. This approval does not send mail.
